0.description:
[Pending Restart] Had you completed attunement to the Eye, it will now automatically add to your collection and players who had already completed this will have it added to their attunement. 

As a reminder: Ascended Eye will require attunement to enter.
[Requires Launcher Update] Fixed an issue preventing the Mythic+ UI from appearing

[Area-52] As previously mentioned before on Alar, Globalized class tokens are tokens that are no longer bound to a specific class. For example, the warrior priest, druid head token from raids is now exchangeable for all classes will be coming to Area-52.

Later Today (1/27/2022) we will begin rolling restarts for Globalized Tier tokens to now drop from bosses and to retroactively update all tier tokens from players to now be this new Global Tier Token.

Tooltips and item descriptions will soon match this new-founded behavior and even giving examples of where to turn them in at.
Fixed an issue where Bottled Nethergron Extract had PvE power instead of PvP Power.
Fixed an issue where Bottled Nethergron Extract could not be bloodforged.
[Requires Launcher Update] Fixed an issue where positive stat increases would show as red on the character frame stat sheet
Fixed an issue where Conqueror Heroic and Ascended Items had the wrong stat values. They are now increased correctly from the Normal Version.

7.description: [Pending restart] Fixed an issue where the disorient from Chaos Meteor did not have any diminishing returns.

5.description: Increased the stat percentage scalar of **some** Mythic+ items found within the Mythic+ Loot Cache.

6.description: [Mythic+] Pending Restart - Removed pooling from Mythical Boons. All Boons will now again spawn throughout their dungeons.
[Mythic+] Pending Restart - Increased the duration of Mythical Boon - Inquisition to 20 seconds up from 10.
[The Eye] [Items] Pending Restart - Bottled Nethergron Extract now has a 1 minute cooldown down from 2 minutes. Slightly increased the scaling of the Heroic and Ascended version.
[The Eye] [Items] Pending Restart - Slightly increased the scaling for the Heroic and Ascended version of Warp-Spring Coil.
[The Eye] [Items] Pending Restart - Increased the Spell power granted by Tome of Fiery Redemption.
[The Eye] [Items] Pending Restart - Solarians Sapphires on use effect now lasts for 15 seconds up from 10. Increased base Stamina of Solarians Sapphire to 40 up from 30.
[The Eye] [Items] Pending Restart - Increased the Spell power scaling of Fel Reavers Piston.
[The Eye] [Items] Pending Restart - Claw of Alar now has a small Spell power scaling. Slightly increased base damage and Attack power scaling.
[The Eye] [Kaelthas Sunstrider] Pending Restart - Kaelthas Nether Beam ability now profits from the haste increase of Burning Wrath.
[The Eye] [Kaelthas Sunstrider] Pending Restart - Phoenix Eggs can now be attacked and destroyed. Devastation is able to execute Phoenix Eggs.
[The Eye] [Kaelthas Sunstrider] Pending Restart - Phoenixes are now able to fly.
[The Eye] [Kaelthas Sunstrider] Pending Restart - Kaelthas will no longer remove Flame Strikes on the ground and no longer unsummon Phoenixes and Eggs when he enters Phase 5.
[The Eye] [Kaelthas Sunstrider] Pending Restart - Increased the healing conversion of Lord Sanguinars Seal of Blood to 200% on Normal and 500% on Heroic difficulty up from 100%.
[The Eye] [Kaelthas Sunstrider] Pending Restart - Corrected some movement issues of Master Engineer Telonicus.

[The Eye] [High Astromancer Solarian] Pending Restart - Corrected an issue where player that got knocked up by Solar Wrath and Lunar Wrath would get a Safe Fall effect. This is only supposed to happen on Normal difficulty. On Heroic and Ascended difficulty only the actual target of the effect gets a Safe Fall effect.
[The Eye] [High Astromancer Solarian] Pending Restart - The Void Storm summoned by High Astromancer Solarian during Phase Two now periodically inflicts Shadow damage to all player.
[The Eye] [Void Reaver] Pending Restart - Activating a Safety Lock now causes the Void Reaver to take damage equal to 20% of his current health.
[The Eye] [Void Reaver] Pending Restart - Increased the health of Void Reaver by 100%.
[The Eye] [Void Reaver] Pounding no longer inflicts percentage damage. Pounding now inflicts flat physical damage. Pounding no longer ignores absorption effects.
[The Eye] [Alar] Pending Restart - Corrected an issue where Alar would sometimes not grant loot upon death.
[The Eye] [Alar] Pending Restart - Flame Breath now increases effected players Fire damage taken by 25% per stack down from 50%.

1.description: [Pending restart] Nightfall can now also trigger from Drain Soul
[Pending restart] Nightfall now has a 4/8% chance to trigger, changed from 3/6%.
[Pending restart] Pandemic now also allows Drain Soul to critically hit.
[Pending restart] Fireball can now trigger the Emberstone Capstone.

7.description: [Pending restart] Eradication now grants 3% additional haste to your Eradication proc, changed from 2%.

0.description: To Honor Ones Elders now only requires 10 achievements to complete instead of all dungeons. This will make this achievement obtainable in both Classic and TBC.
Elders of the Dungeons now only requires 6 achievements to complete instead of all dungeons. This will make this achievement obtainable in both Classic and TBC.
Gordok Green Grog now stacks up to 100 times from 10 times.
Kreegs Stout Beetdown now stacks up to 100 times, from 10 times.
Flask of the Warsong (uncommon, rare and epic) now provide 25% more Strength on the Flask Buff. This change is meant to bring it up to par with other Flasks.
Flask of Butchery (uncommon, rare and epic) now provide 25% more agility on the Flask Buff. This change is meant to bring it up to par with other Flasks.
Vulture La King (uncommon, rare and epic) now provide 25% more spellpower on the Well Fed Buff. This change is meant to bring it up to par with other Well Fed Buffs.

Fixed an issue where High-Risk cooking consumables would show up as the first rarity of the item you were creating. I.e. all ranks of Jurassic Soup would display as "Jurassic Soup" despite making different items. They will now display correctly as:

"Jurassic Soup"
"Tasty Jurassic Soup"
"Delicious Jurassic Soup"
High-Risk Well Fed buffs will no longer display as "Well Fed" in the buff bar, instead they will display as "Well Fed - Item Name". Example: "Well Fed - Jurassic Soup".

1.description:
Haste Cooldowns like Nature\'s Swiftness and Icy Veins will now remain active at the same time simultaneously, however, only the stronger effect will be active. 

This change allows you to use your Nature Swiftness without losing the stronger Haste Buff & Silence Protection from Icy Veins. This rule also applies to Elemental Mastery, Power Infusion, Icy Veins, Berserking (Troll Racial) and Nature\'s Swiftness.
[Pending restart] Sinister Strike now deals 85% damage when used with a 2-handed weapon, changed from 80%.
[Pending restart] Unrelenting Storm now also increases your melee haste in addition to its previous effects.
[Pending restart] Reduced the global cooldown of Rockbiter Weapon to 1 sec, changed from 1.5 sec.
[Pending restart] Booming Echoes now lasts for 12 sec, changed from 10.
[Pending restart] Thunder Clap can now be used while silenced. (To improve its reliability in PvE.)

[Pending restart] Reduced the global cooldown of a lot of buffs to 1 sec, changed from 1.5 sec. The affected buffs are: Amplify Magic, Arcane Brilliance, Arcane Intellect, Battle Shout, Blessing of Kings, Blessing of Might, Blessing of Sanctuary, Blessing of Wisdom, Commanding Shout, Concentration Aura, Crusader Aura, Dampen Magic, Devotion Aura, Divine Spirit, Earthliving Weapon, Fire Resistance Aura, Flametongue Weapon, Frost Resistance Aura, Frostbrand Weapon, Gift of the Wild, Greater Blessing of Kings, Greater Blessing of Might, Greater Blessing of Sanctuary, Greater Blessing of Wisdom, Ice Armor, Inner Fire, Mark of the Wild, Power Word: Fortitude, Prayer of Fortitude, Prayer of Shadow Protection, Prayer of Spirit, Retribution Aura, Righteous Fury, Seal of Command, Seal of Light, Seal of Righteousness, Seal of Vengeance, Seal of Wisdom, Shadow Protection, Shadow Resistance Aura, Thorns, Trueshot Aura, Unending Breath, Water Breathing, Water Walking, Windfury Weapon.

5.description: [Pending restart] The Deathmantle 4-set bonus will now correctly trigger from all finishing moves.

6.description: [Serpentshrine] [Lady Vashj] Pending Restart - Reduced the level of Coilfang Elites to 72 down from 73.
[The Eye] [Kaelthas Sunstrider] Pending Restart - Evocations secondary effect now lasts until the end of combat.

[The Eye] [Kaelthas Sunstrider] Pending Restart - Pyroblasts damage over time effect is now a magic effect that can be dispelled. Pryroblast has a higher spell priority then Fireball and will always be dispelled first.
[The Eye] [Kaelthas Sunstrider] Pending Restart - Overwhelming Power now also increases Kaelthas mana costs by 100%.
[The Eye] [Kaelthas Sunstrider] Pending Restart - Corrected an issue where Kaelthas Burning Blade would fail to trigger its effect after being interrupted.

[The Eye] [High Astromancer Solarian] Pending Restart - Corrected an issue where Solarian Priests and Agents Solar Blades would fail to trigger their effect after being silenced or interrupted. Corrected an issue where Lunarian Priests and Agents Lunar Blades would fail to trigger their effect after being silenced or interrupted.

[The Eye] [Kaelthas Sunstrider] Pending Restart - The Legendary Weapon - Staff of Disintegration, now removes already active Disorientation and Fear effects from targets that the Mental Protection Field is applied to.

[The Eye] [Kaelthas Sunstrider] The Legendary Weapon - Devastation, now absorbs up to 1 million Magic damage while its effect is channelled- Devastation no longer deflects incoming spells. The tooltipp will be updated with a later patch.
Pending Restarts - Reduced the cast range for creatures using the Ascension version of Cleave, Sundering Cleave, Mortal Cleave, Shadow Cleave and Draconic Cleave.

7.description: [Pending restart] Undaunted no longer requires Stagger to be active to trigger a cooldown reduction to your Last Stand.

8.description: Pending Restart - Kaelthas and the Verdant Sphere quests are now repeatable.

1.description: [Pending restart] Demonic Resilience now increases the threat generated during Metamorphosis by 25/50/75%, changed from 10/20/30%.
[Pending restart] Consecrate (Emanate) will no longer cause spell pushback.
Fixed an issue where Consecration (Emanate) with a certain combination of talents would deal far more damage than intended compared to the normal Consecration.

0.description: Temporarily suspended the sales of Mystic Orbs & Mystic Runes due to a bug. This is only temporary and is a high priority to fix. The reason for these items being disabled is because when purchasing the runes or orbs it can cause you to gain an extra orb and rune that could override the amount you have already.
Fixed an issue where the Striker Tier 2.5 set would not proc from the periodic damage of Explosive Shot.
Based on player feedback, the Striker Tier 2.5 set now has a 2 second ICD from 3 seconds.
Corruptor Scourgestones, Invader's Scourgestone, Minion's Scourgestone will now be sellable to the vendor and will be automatically vendored and added to the total gold when mythic+ is completed.
Genesis t2.5 set will now proc off of all HoT effects instead of just nature.
Fixed an issue where the Frostwolf Clan Commendation Badge was missing from the Alterac Valley vendor (this allows you to gain reputation for honor).
Reduced cost of Mythic+ Upgrades by 25%

7.description: [Pending restart] Shadow Strikes no longer requires Shadowform to trigger Nightfall.

1.description: [Pending restart] Fixed an issue where the damage bonus from Dissolving Shadows would not work properly.
[Pending restart] Fixed an issue where using Deterrence could trigger Burning Determination.

6.description: [The Shattered Halls] Removed three Shattered Hand Assassins between Warbringer Omrogg and Warchief Kargath Bladefist.
[The Shattered Halls] [Blood Guard Porung] Corrected an issue where Blood Guard Porung would grant a higher amount of reputation then intended on Normal difficulty.
[Hellfire Citadel] Corrected multiple issues where creatures that should give reputation would grant none.
[Hellfire Citadel] Corrected multiple issues where summoned creatures would grant reputation.
[Hellfire Citadel] Corrected multiple issues where creatures would stop giving reputation to early.
[Mythic+] Pending Restart - Mythical Boon Inquisition now increases in damage with the dungeons Mythic Level.
[Mythic+] Pending Restart - Mythic+ creatures now gain 0.375% attack speed per Mythic level. At Mythic level 40 they will reach an attack speed equivalent to AQT and Naxxramas creatures attack speed.

[Mythic+] Pending Restart - Corrected an issue where Mythical Boons would not spawn pooled as intended. When starting a Mythic+ run only the  selected Boons from their pool will now be spawned. Pool selection is the same for every individual run and only get rerolled after a Server Restart.

1.description: [Pending restart] Casting Mass Dispel will no longer cause you to leave Tree of Life.
Earth Shield, Lightning Shield and Water Shield can now be active at the same time!

0.description: Fixed an issue with a recent patch causing groups to fail to show in raid frames. Requires patch update.
Patch Pending, corrected the tooltip of Stormstrike.
Fixed an issue where only one dungeon daily could be active at a time.
Fixed a rare case where Bug Trio on 25 Player Ascended difficulty could sometimes fail to drop tier tokens.
Doubled the effectiveness of the Mythical Boon: Wrathful.
Adding a recycling option for Mythic+ items. You can exchange unwanted Mythic+ items for 25 mythic coins.
Grey, White, and Green items will now be vendored in Mythic+ Automatically for gold to help mitigate lootplsion.

7.description: [Pending restart] Forbidden Technique now has a 30 yard range and can no longer miss. (This change was made to improve its consistency.)
